systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Mainstream commentary often suggests global crude benchmarks remain largely balanced.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: The $2.52 Brent-WTI spread may indicate that seaborne crude reflects elevated maritime transit and insurance considerations relative to domestic pipeline grades, while current SPR levels (282,184 k bbl) could suggest limited room for sustained strategic buffer deployment.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Market summaries frequently interpret headline 6-currency DXY movements as reflecting neutral broader dollar conditions.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: The Fed's 26-currency trade-weighted Broad Dollar (122.65) alongside positive SOFR spread (5.00 bps) can be viewed as an indication that localized offshore dollar funding frictions and supply-chain related currency pressures may be developing across emerging partner economies.

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: CHOKE_HORMUZ: 2 vessels/day (-97.8% vs 2023 Base) | CHOKE_TURKISH_STRAITS: -40.7% vs 2023 Base
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Diplomatic statements and headline reporting generally emphasize corridor continuity and stabilization efforts.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: IMF PortWatch satellite AIS telemetry confirms official commercial transits have registered significant contraction (Hormuz at 2 daily vessels, -97.8% vs 2023 Base); observed physical flows may increasingly be shaped by specialized operational parameters, including military naval escort coordination and intermittent transponder management, rather than standardized peacetime commercial routing.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Trade overviews tend to highlight the immediate dampening effect of direct bilateral technology export controls.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Persistent hardware stress readings (0.524) and elevated logistics friction (1.26 Z-Score) could suggest that tech supply networks might be partially adapting through regional intermediary hubs, potentially contributing to higher intermediary transaction costs.

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: MODEL_28_4_SPILLOVER: 50 (MODERATE_FRICTION) | Net Deficit: 13.36 mbpd (65.2%) | IL_IR Polarity: -0.87
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Public infrastructure reviews often cite overland pipeline capacity as an adaptable alternative to maritime bottlenecks.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Model 28.4 parameter calculations suggest that existing regional pipeline alternatives (7.14 mbpd buffer capacity) may face structural throughput ceilings relative to aggregate baseline requirements (13.36 mbpd calculated gap), implying that full substitution might require extended operational adjustments under prevailing tension (-0.87).

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: CHOKE_MALACCA: 258 vessels/day (+31.8% vs 2023 Base) | US_CN Baseline Polarity: -0.65 | NYFED_GSCPI: 1.26 Z-Score
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Regulatory announcements typically frame export licensing regimes primarily through the lens of direct bilateral trade balances.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: A +31.8% vs 2023 Base maritime volume shift at Malacca combined with supply chain friction indicators (1.26 Z-Score) may indicate that trade flows could be experiencing geographical rerouting via Southeast Asian transit hubs, potentially introducing secondary compliance and logistics complexity under bilateral friction (-0.65).
